title: Character Subclass
description: Defines a character subclass (or specialization) with its unique identity, UI theme, and branching talent tree.

class_id.description: The ID of the base class this subclass belongs to, e.g., 'mystic'.

name.description: The display name of the subclass.

alignment_theme.description: The general moral or ethical alignment associated with this subclass's fantasy.

properties.$comment: SECTION 2: UI THEME FOR THE PROGRESSION CONSTELLATION

talent_tree_theme.description: A data-driven style guide for this subclass's unique UI in the progression screen.

background_diorama.description: A narrative description of the 'Living Diorama' background scene.

node_style.description: Describes the shape and feel of the talent nodes (e.g., 'Hexagonal and technical', 'Soft, glowing orbs').

connection_style.description: Describes the look of the lines connecting the nodes (e.g., 'Sharp laser lines', 'Flowing streams of Force energy').

primary.description: Primary hex color for UI elements.

ambient_audio.description: Description of the background audio loop for this screen (e.g., 'The hum of a starship engine').

narrative.description: A rich, multi-sentence paragraph describing the subclass fantasy, its methods, and its role in the galaxy.

flavor_text.description: An iconic, thematic quote that captures the essence of the subclass.

tags.description: UNIVERSAL TAGGING SYSTEM (Genesis Protocol Article II): Tags that define this subclass' specialization and characteristics. All tags must be defined in master_tags.yml.

class_identity_profile.description: The core thematic elements that define this subclass.

core_fantasy.description: A single, punchy sentence defining the playstyle.

key_attributes.description: The primary ability scores for this subclass.

iconic_gear.description: Equipment strongly associated with this subclass.

role_in_galaxy.description: The subclass's typical role or function in galactic society.

famous_exemplars.description: Famous characters from lore who embody this subclass.

properties.$comment: MIGRATION NOTE: species_synergies and faction_synergies in class_identity_profile are DEPRECATED per Genesis Protocol Article III. Migrate to synergy_rules.yml using tags.

species_synergies.description: DEPRECATED: Use tags and synergy_rules.yml instead.

faction_synergies.description: DEPRECATED: Use tags and synergy_rules.yml instead.

properties.$comment: SECTION 4: TALENT TREE (The FFG-style Branching Progression)

talent_tree.description: The complete, branching talent tree for this specialization. Progression is handled by spending XP to purchase nodes.

id.description: A unique ID for this specific node in the tree, e.g., 'bw_t1_empathy'.

feature_id.description: The ID of the feature this node grants, linking to a file in the /features/ directory.

tier.description: The vertical tier of the talent (typically 1-5).

column.description: The horizontal column of the talent, for UI positioning.

prerequisites.description: A list of talent node IDs that must be purchased before this one.

connections.description: A list of talent node IDs that this node unlocks.

roleplay_guidance.description: Detailed advice for the LLM-GM on how to portray a character of this subclass.

narrative_hooks.description: Story ideas that are a perfect fit for this subclass.

tactical_notes.description: Advice for the LLM-GM on how to effectively use this subclass's abilities in combat.
